nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Medical insurance scheme for eligible Kerala government employees and pensioners, providing cashless treatment through the scheme network.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Kerala state government employees, pensioners and covered dependants under MEDISEP rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Kerala MEDISEP.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
